criteria.name: Architecture Fidelity
criteria.grading_prompt: Do architecture decisions serve the specific needs of this idea, or are they generic best practices?

anchors.PASS: Decisions reference specific capabilities and constraints from this idea
anchors.PARTIAL: Some decisions are idea-specific, others are generic defaults
anchors.FAIL: Architecture is a generic template with no connection to the specific idea

criteria.name: Architecture Specificity
criteria.grading_prompt: Are technology choices named (specific services, frameworks, libraries), or just categories?

anchors.PASS: Named technologies with rationale tied to specific capabilities (e.g., 'Supabase for auth because CAP-001 requires social login')
anchors.PARTIAL: Named technologies but rationale is generic ('industry standard', 'popular choice')
anchors.FAIL: Only categories named ('a database', 'an auth provider') with no specific technology selected

criteria.name: Architecture Completeness
criteria.grading_prompt: Does project.md cover all DEC-* decisions with rationale? Is the build/buy table complete? Are dependencies specific (named packages with versions)?

anchors.PASS: All decisions documented with rationale, dependencies are specific
anchors.PARTIAL: Some decisions lack rationale or dependencies are vague
